feedback.delta: Make textual_capability_name never_confers authority executable: bearer possession must be host-verifiable and non-structurally-forgeable. Prefer descriptor/ref in Clay plus opaque/sealed runtime handle or equivalently strong signed-token mechanism. No syntax change yet.
H-WP-10/APP-08 should include broker-vs-ambient differential, structural-token forgery, child-process/FFI authority-closure, revocation and confused-deputy tests.
Supports existing fixed boundary that Needle/model outputs propose effects but do not mint authority; no FRANK architecture target change.
Safe-Effect H-SYSTEM gains a concrete negative control: ambient foreign-code authority falsifies semantic action-space containment even when effect intent is typed.

Persist descriptors, scopes, issuer/revocation metadata and receipts; do not treat serialized capability IDs/records in semantic tables as bearer authority unless an independently protected runtime validation root exists.
Proposal/activation/authority typed firebreak should terminate in an opaque/sealed broker capability root; topology/activation cannot synthesize possession.
Existing rule derived graph relation cannot authorize effect remains sufficient for this run; no graph primitive change supported.
Existing no-authority-from-selection/broadcast rule remains sufficient; effect selection must flow to external broker.
No emergence-measurement semantic change; preserve rule that emergent/causal readouts never mint authority.
